studentFeatures.title: Student Notification Center
studentFeatures.description: View live alerts for pass approvals, seat changes, fee receipts, and library notices with the new notification bell on your home screen.

studentFeatures.description: Instant live sync with official library admin and manager details with 1-tap call and pre-formatted WhatsApp assistance.

studentFeatures.title: Rotating Refresh & Full Data Sync

adminFeatures.title: Student Notification Center Stream
